import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
cfg = dict(nx=4, ny=3, J1=1.0, J2=0.4, Delta=0.5)
N = 12
occ = sorted((x if y % 2 == 0 else 3 - x) + y * 4 for x in range(4) for y in range(3) if (x + y) % 2 == 0)
C = np.eye(N)[:, occ + [q for q in range(N) if q not in occ]]
k = np.arange(N)
G = 0.7 * np.sin(np.add.outer(k, 2 * k) + 1.0) + 0.3j * np.cos(np.add.outer(2 * k, k))
C = expm(G - G.conj().T) @ C
rho = C[:, :N // 2] @ C[:, :N // 2].conj().T
def probe(K):
    p = np.arange(K.shape[0])
    P, Q, R, S = np.ix_(p, p, p, p)
    W1 = np.cos(0.7 * P + 1.3 * Q + 0.4 * R + 2.1 * S + 0.5)
    W2 = np.sin(1.1 * P - 0.6 * Q + 0.9 * R + 0.3 * S + 0.2) + 1j * np.cos(0.8 * P + 0.5 * Q - 1.2 * R + 0.7 * S)
    W3 = 1.0 + 0.5 * np.cos(0.3 * P - 0.9 * Q + 1.7 * R - 0.4 * S)
    return np.array([np.sum(K * W1), np.sum(K * W2), np.sum(np.abs(K) * W3), np.linalg.norm(K)])
cfg_ref = dict(cfg)
rho_ref = rho.copy()
assert np.allclose(probe(fock_kernel(rho, cfg)), target)
